title: What the GString headers do not do

entities.title: Declared, never implemented
entities.summary: The headers declare an interface and define none of it, apart from a few one-line accessors written inline.
entities.impact: Nothing that includes them can link or run. Every behavior the comments describe (copy-on-write, conversion that replaces the payload, comparison that shares it, the GSpot's resync, the regular-expression budget) is a description of what GString did, not something this code does.

entities.title: Windows only
entities.summary: gconfig.hpp stops the build with #error on anything but Windows, unless GSTRING_SYNTAX_CHECK is defined.
entities.impact: Unix, with its four-byte wchar_t, is not supported. GSTRING_SYNTAX_CHECK only lets a modern compiler read the declarations; it replaces windows.h and oleauto.h with typedefs for OLECHAR and BSTR, and nothing built that way would run.
entities.workaround: Define GSTRING_SYNTAX_CHECK to check the declarations on another platform.

entities.title: No embedded nulls
entities.summary: A GString holds no null characters; a BSTR may, and GString would not accept them.
entities.impact: Binary data, or a BSTR carrying nulls, cannot be held as a GString.

entities.title: A character is a code point
entities.summary: Lengths, GSpot steps and comparisons count code points; extended grapheme clusters arrived in 2008, after GString.
entities.impact: A flag, an emoji sequence or a letter with a combining accent counts as several characters.

entities.title: Nothing is normalised
entities.summary: Compare goes by code point whatever the payloads, and nothing is normalised, so é as one code point and é as e and an accent are different strings.
entities.impact: Canonically equivalent text compares unequal, as it did everywhere else in the building. Collate goes by the process's locale, which on a server was the server's.

entities.title: Case mapping ignores the locale
entities.summary: The upper case of i is I everywhere, including Turkey; none of the factions' old classes knew the dotless ı, and GString gave each faction the answer its old class gave.
entities.impact: Turkish text is upper- and lower-cased wrongly.

entities.title: Limited backtracking
entities.summary: GRegularExpression supports backtracking only to a budget of steps per match; running out is the outcome TooAmbitious, never a hung server.
entities.impact: A pattern that needs more backtracking than the budget gets TooAmbitious instead of a match, and needs rewriting.

entities.title: No operator[]
entities.summary: GString has no direct indexing; a position is a GSpot, and only a fixed-width payload can jump straight to one.
entities.impact: Reaching the nth character of a variable-width payload means walking to it.
